summary: The iOS screenshot demo gateway serves the shared fleet-mid-refactor scenario through the scenario kit replay instead of maintaining a separate handwritten world

replay.detail: Demo HTTP and WebSocket adapters now use the scenario kit createReplay; landing captures pin the kit anchor and a frozen manual clock, while ordinary demos use a real clock. No daemon replay change.

schema.detail: No wire schema changes. Gateway integration coverage strictly decodes HTTP envelopes and collection frames with the client schemas and exercises the iOS Now and conversation feed.

compatibility.detail: Demo capture expectations now use the fleet-mid-refactor review attention and Atlas Builder conversation. Demo-only cryptographic pairing and eight-second WebSocket heartbeats remain intact; capture mode freezes scenario state at the kit anchor.

manual.detail: Install workspace dependencies before running the demo, and launch it with node --experimental-transform-types demoGateway.mjs. The landing capture script supplies the flag. Keep this unauthenticated demo restricted to Debug simulators.

recovery.detail: Revert this change to restore the previous screenshot demo.
